description: Test class for validating XML configuration files against a DTD for OpenMRS modules. Contains parameterized tests that verify the correctness of various module configuration XML structures, including elements like extensions, privileges, global properties, libraries, and servlet definitions.

classes.name: ModuleConfigDTDTest_V1_0
classes.description: Test suite for verifying valid and invalid configurations of module descriptor XML files against a specific DTD version (1.0).

methods.name: getCompatibleVersions
methods.description: Provides a stream of version arguments to parameterized tests, covering compatible module versions from 1.0 to 2.0.
